item.text: {"search_note":"I found solid crisis-related evidence for Manipur, J&K, Ukraine diplomacy, and food-inflation stress, but little independent 2024 evidence on pandemics, famine, or major natural disasters specific to Modi’s decisionmaking. The strongest positive items are mostly official relief statements or diplomatic rhetoric; the strongest negative items are independent rights and Reuters reporting on failure, coercion, and unmet household distress.","evidence":[{"title":"The Home Ministry said it was committed to safety for citizens in Manipur and outlined support for food, water, medicine, health, education, and rehabilitation for displaced people","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Home Affairs","date":"17 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2025980&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"The government publicly promised a protection-and-relief response for displaced people in Manipur, including force deployment and basic services, which is positive but reactive crisis mitigation.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3"]},{"title":"Modi said India’s approach was “people-centric” and called 2024","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2015753&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"Modi framed the Ukraine crisis around diplomacy rather than escalation, which is relevant as a harm-reduction posture during an active conflict.","question_ids":["6B.6","1B.1","1B.4"]},{"title":"Reuters reported Modi used emotive, pro-civilian language to rebuke Putin after the hospital strike in Ukraine","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"9 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indias-modi-tells-putin-that-heart-bleeds-when-children-are-killed-3512452","summary":"Modi publicly emphasized civilian protection in a live war context, which supports a limited reading of avoidable-suffering reduction through diplomacy and moral pressure.","question_ids":["6B.6","1B.1"]},{"title":"The interim budget centered the poor, women, youth, and farmers while avoiding a classic giveaway","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"1 Feb distribution-focused budget, which is indirect positive evidence that it was trying to soften economic stress without pure patronage.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3","6B.4"]},{"title":"HRW said the government stigmatized minorities, Manipur saw deaths and displacement, and the state prolonged internet shutdowns","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"11 Jan effectively stop the crisis or protect victims, so avoidable suffering persisted despite official relief language.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3","6B.8"]},{"title":"Reuters reported tear gas, stun rather than a clearly protective or restorative strategy, which weakens the case for suffering reduction.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.8"]},{"title":"Reuters reported school meal budgets had not kept extrajudicial killings, and other serious abuses in Jammu and Kashmir","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"31 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/31/india-repression-persists-jammu-and-kashmir","summary":"The state’s coercive security posture in J&K remained a source of avoidable suffering rather than a clear mitigation of crisis harms.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.8"]}]}
